```yaml
name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      merge_method:
        description: 'Merge method to use (merge, squash, rebase)'
        required: false
        default: 'merge'
        type: choice
        options:
          - merge
          - squash
          - rebase

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge-branches:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch latest changes
        run: |
          git fetch origin dev
          git fetch origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          git merge origin/dev --no-edit --strategy-option theirs || true
          
          # If there are conflicts, try to resolve them by accepting theirs (dev branch)
          if ! git diff --quiet --merge; then
            echo "Conflicts detected, resolving by accepting dev branch changes..."
            git checkout --theirs .
            git add .
            git commit -m "Auto-resolve merge conflicts from dev into features/hubs-recs"
          fi

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Verify build
        run: |
          # Basic verification that the branch is in a valid state
          git status
          git log --oneline -5
```
